messages:
alex_cust: Hey team, hitting consistent parse failures when using JSON mode strict. Our client gets a 422 'invalid json' even though model output looks like JSON in logs. Started after a small infra update.

maria_support: sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact request + headers? do you set response_format or response_format.strict?

alex_cust: we call POST /v1/generate with query param response_format=json and header \"Content-Type: application/json\" and include \"accept: application/json\". server responded 422, body: 'invalid json output'. here's the raw body from our capture (trimmed):

\t\uFEFF{
\t  \"id\": \"resp_123\",
\t  \"choices\": [{\"text\":\"{\\\"result\\\": true}\"}]
\t}

alex_cust: note there's a weird leading character in the capture (looks like a BOM). our parser rejects it in strict mode.

maria_support: aha. can you also include response headers from the API response (the Redwood endpoint)? sometimes upstream HTML error pages slip through with text/html content-type and strict mode rejects even if body looks JSON.

alex_cust: got headers: 

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-16
content-length: 128

alex_cust: so charset=utf-16 and the BOM \uFEFF is present. we think the runtime's strict JSON enforcement is failing to normalize BOM/charset before parsing.

devon_engineer: thanks, this is helpful. two issues to investigate: 1) strict JSON enforcement currently assumes utf-8 and rejects content with other charsets/BOMs, 2) content-type sniffing — if upstream returns text/html or has mismatched charset we should fallback gracefully unless strict=true. can you repro with curl and include --include so we see headers?

alex_cust: repro command I used: 

curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -H 'Accept: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"{\"q\":\"ok\"}","response_format":"json","response_format.strict":true}'

alex_cust: response (raw): 

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-16
\uFEFF{
  \"id\": \"resp_123\",
  \"choices\": [{\"text\":\"{\\\"result\\\": true}\"}]
}

maria_support: workaround for now: remove response_format.strict or set it to false on the client OR normalize the bytes before parsing (strip BOM and transcode utf-16 -> utf-8). we'll patch upstream but need logs to confirm frequency.

devon_engineer: created repro script and validated. when Content-Type includes charset=utf-16 the runtime isn't applying a charset convert step before JSON parse in strict path. permissive path does try to transcode.

kai_sre: tagging for escalation. @devon_engineer can you open an infra task? this might be related to the HTTP client library change in the last deploy (see deploy-bot note).

deploy-bot: deploy finished: canary/2026-03-12-cc3a9a (libhttp v2.4.1)

devon_engineer: filing internal ticket INF-4921: strict-json rejects non-utf8 BOM; reproducible with provided curl. temporary mitigation: server will add Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 when possible and add bytes-normalization for strict path.

alex_cust: thx for the quick triage. can you confirm ETA for a client-safe fix? this is breaking our pipeline.

maria_support: short-term ETA: config change in edge to force utf-8 header within 24 hours. medium-term: code fix to normalize BOM in strict mode rolling next week. I'll update you when INF-4921 makes progress. :thumbsup:

alex_cust: appreciated, leaving this thread open until fixed. will test the header-forcing workaround and report back.
